description: This file defines the main dashboard page component for a React web application that manages user authentication, navigation, and data display for Jira and Confluence services. It orchestrates context hooks, handles user interactions for login/logout, and conditionally renders UI components based on authentication and connection state.

methods.name: handleConnect
methods.description: Handles user connection/authentication process based on selected method and service, manages data fetching upon successful login.

methods.name: getSectionTitle
methods.description: Computes the display title for the current service section based on connection state.

methods.name: getSectionSubtitle
methods.description: Computes the subtitle message guiding user actions based on service connection state.
